title: model
description: Cross-family type reference: named types, their descriptions, and occurrence paths across all schemas. Occurrence keys use the de-versioned family-dir grammar (join.csv's): the family's address under rsc/schema, resolved against the family's latest version; values are instance JSON Pointers into a datum of that family. Curated under the two-loop disposal discipline of issues/19: the name scan feeds join.csv at leisure; a join edge asserting one shared type obligates an entry here or a rejection in rejected.txt, gated by check_metamodel_obligations; check_metamodel_occurrences holds these pointers to the schemas; the table rsc/metamodel/metamodel.json validates against this schema (check_metamodel_table).
